title: Small-cap stocks enjoy their best first half in 35 years. Here's what's driving it
title_zh: 小盘股上半年表现 35 年来最好。这就是推动它的因素
text: The advance marks a sharp turnaround after years of underperformance versus large-cap peers.
zh: 此次上涨标志着多年来与大盘股相比表现不佳之后的急剧转变。

title: White House AI crackdown opens door for Chinese model makers to close gap
title_zh: 白宫对人工智能的打击为中国模型制造商缩小差距打开了大门
text: The Trump administration's crackdown on Anthropic's leading artificial intelligence models is looking like a gift to China.
zh: 特朗普政府对 Anthropic 领先的人工智能模型的打击看起来像是送给中国的一份礼物。

title: Trump's defense budget, depleted war machine, spark state battle for business and jobs
title_zh: 特朗普的国防预算、耗尽的战争机器引发了各州的商业和就业之战
text: Trump's huge defense budget request and a race to replenish weapons stocks while building hypersonic missiles lead to war between U.S. states for jobs.
zh: 特朗普巨额国防预算要求以及在制造高超音速导弹的同时补充武器库存的竞赛导致了美国各州之间的就业战争。

title: Comcast's NBCUniversal spinoff raises hope for more deals. There may not be good options
title_zh: 康卡斯特 (Comcast) 的 NBC环球 (NBCUniversal) 分拆项目引发了更多交易的希望。可能没有好的选择
text: Comcast plans to separate its cable and media divisions over the next year. This could set each company up for M&A, but there might not be any good options.
zh: 康卡斯特计划在明年将其有线电视和媒体部门分开。这可能会让每家公司都做好并购的准备，但可能没有什么好的选择。

title: Eli Lilly, Regeneron among first companies selected for FDA initiative to speed review of new manufacturing facilities
title_zh: 礼来 (Eli Lilly) 和再生元 (Regeneron) 是首批入选 FDA 计划的公司之一，以加快对新生产设施的审查
text: Eli Lilly and Regeneron are among the first seven companies the FDA has selected for its PreCheck Pilot Program, CNBC has learned.
zh: 据 CNBC 获悉，礼来公司 (Eli Lilly) 和再生元 (Regeneron) 是 FDA 首批选定的七家公司之一，参与其 PreCheck 试点计划。

title: Micron's monster post-earnings rally is almost gone. Traders divided on where it goes next
title_zh: 美光科技公布财报后的强劲反弹几乎已经消失。交易员对下一步走向存在分歧
text: The maker of memory chips slid to start the week, marking an about-face from its post-earnings surge.
zh: 这家存储芯片制造商本周开盘下滑，标志着其盈利后飙升的局面发生了转变。

title: ‘We are more likely to be living in poverty’: Social Security is a lifeline for women, so why are we ignored?
title_zh: “我们更有可能生活在贫困之中”：社会保障是女性的生命线，为何我们却被忽视？
text: “We are more likely to live longer, to live alone and to be caregivers.”
zh: “我们更有可能活得更久，独自生活并成为照顾者。”

title: Fighting, bitterness and estrangement: How eldercare is ripping siblings apart
title_zh: 争吵、痛苦和疏远：老年护理如何导致兄弟姐妹分裂
text: “My brother doesn’t even call to ask about our mother”: The eldercare burden is often compounded by difficult relationships between brothers and sisters.
zh: “我哥哥甚至不打电话询问我们母亲的情况”：兄弟姐妹之间的困难关系往往加剧了老人的照顾负担。

title: ‘She wants him gone’: My friend took in a homeless man as a caretaker. After 10 years, how can she evict him?
title_zh: “她希望他离开”：我的朋友收留了一名无家可归的人作为看护人。十年了，她怎么能赶走他？
text: “He lived rent-free, helping her with health-related issues and other tasks.”
zh: “他免租居住，帮助她解决与健康相关的问题和其他任务。”

title: A 23% plunge in personal wealth leaves this country trailing its global peers
title_zh: 个人财富暴跌 23%，使该国落后于全球其他国家
text: The average wealth per person has rapidly dropped in this country — and it’s not looking good compared with other developed markets.
zh: 这个国家的人均财富迅速下降——与其他发达市场相比，情况看起来并不好。

title: 20 stocks in the S&P 500 that plunged the most in 2026’s first half
title_zh: 2026年上半年标普500指数跌幅最大的20只股票
text: These companies were hit hard as investors worried about eventual losses of market share to AI tools.
zh: 由于投资者担心人工智能工具最终会失去市场份额，这些公司受到了沉重打击。

title: China in the Year of the Horse: A stable trot or a brisk gallop? - J.P. Morgan Private Bank
title_zh: 马年的中国：稳健的小跑还是轻快的驰骋？ - 摩根大通私人银行
text: China in the Year of the Horse: A stable trot or a brisk gallop? J.P. Morgan Private Bank
zh: 马年的中国：稳健的小跑还是轻快的驰骋？摩根大通私人银行

title: Commentary: What China’s underperforming tech stocks say about its real economy - CNA
title_zh: 评论：中国表现不佳的科技股对其实体经济有何影响 - CNA
text: Commentary: What China’s underperforming tech stocks say about its real economy CNA
zh: 评论：中国表现不佳的科技股对其实体经济有何影响 CNA

title: ‘Tell the story well’: China pushes brokerages to shape stock market narrative - South China Morning Post
title_zh: “讲好故事”：中国推动券商塑造股市叙事 - 南华早报
text: ‘Tell the story well’: China pushes brokerages to shape stock market narrative South China Morning Post
zh: “讲好故事”：中国推动券商塑造股市叙事 南华早报

title: Who ate all the Chinese stock market returns? - Financial Times
title_zh: 中国股市的收益全部被谁吃掉了？ - 金融时报
text: Who ate all the Chinese stock market returns? Financial Times
zh: 中国股市的收益全部被谁吃掉了？金融时报

title: Mag 7 value shrinks by $2.3 trillion amid AI spending jitters — but investors are still backing chipmakers
title_zh: 由于人工智能支出紧张，Mag 7 价值缩水 2.3 万亿美元 - 但投资者仍在支持芯片制造商
text: Investors are growing jittery about massive AI spending by the Mag 7 and when these companies will produce a return on that investment.
zh: 投资者对 Mag 7 的巨额人工智能支出以及这些公司何时能获得投资回报越来越感到不安。

title: Oil prices set for steep monthly drop as Trump, Iran issue mixed messages on talks in Qatar
title_zh: 特朗普和伊朗就卡塔尔会谈发出混杂信息，油价预计每月大幅下跌
text: The moves come as oil traders monitor the prospect of U.S.-Iran talks in Doha on Tuesday.
zh: 这些举措出台之际，石油交易商正在密切关注周二在多哈举行的美伊谈判的前景。

title: Do you really, really love your job? Then you're not alone, according to surprising results from this survey
title_zh: 你真的、真的热爱你的工作吗？根据这项调查的令人惊讶的结果，你并不孤单
text: Those surveyed showed a 78.9% rate of workers who "reported feeling positive at the end of their shifts."
zh: 受访者显示，78.9% 的员工“表示在轮班结束时感觉积极”。

title: Medicare will start covering obesity drugs for the first time. Here's what patients should know
title_zh: 医疗保险将首次开始承保肥胖药物。这是患者应该知道的
text: The move could unlock millions of new patients for Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly and expand access to medications that were previously out of reach for seniors.
zh: 此举可以为诺和诺德和礼来公司释放数百万新患者，并扩大老年人获得以前无法获得的药物的机会。

title: Here's how Trump Accounts could affect women's retirement savings gap
title_zh: 以下是特朗普账户如何影响女性退休储蓄缺口
text: While Trump Accounts are unlikely to directly improve retirement savings among women, there may be an indirect benefit, says one expert.
zh: 一位专家表示，虽然特朗普账户不太可能直接提高女性的退休储蓄，但可能会带来间接的好处。

title: Digital Realty falls 5% after taking $3.5 billion stake in Blackstone's Virginia data centers
title_zh: Digital Realty 斥资 35 亿美元收购 Blackstone 弗吉尼亚数据中心股份，股价下跌 5%
text: Digital Realty fell in premarket trading Tuesday after it announced its buying a $3.5 billion stake in three data centers from asset manager Blackstone.
zh: Digital Realty 宣布从资产管理公司 Blackstone 手中购买价值 35 亿美元的三个数据中心股份，周二盘前交易中股价下跌。

title: Indonesia jails former education minister for 10 years in Google Chromebook graft case
title_zh: 印度尼西亚前教育部长因 Google Chromebook 贪污案被判入狱 10 年
text: Makarim was found guilty in a case over the procurement of Google Chromebooks for schools
zh: Makarim 在为学校采购 Google Chromebook 的案件中被判有罪

title: Global recession is inevitable if Strait of Hormuz stays shut, says Citadel's Ken Griffin
title_zh: Citadel 的 Ken Griffin 表示，如果霍尔木兹海峡继续关闭，全球经济衰退将不可避免
text: A prolonged blockage of the Strait of Hormuz for the next six to 12 months will mean an unavoidable recession, the billionaire investor said.
zh: 这位亿万富翁投资者表示，未来 6 到 12 个月霍尔木兹海峡的长期封锁将意味着不可避免的经济衰退。

title: The big surprise for the year’s second half could be the AI trade powering higher. Why it wouldn’t take much.
title_zh: 今年下半年的最大惊喜可能是人工智能贸易的走高。为什么不需要太多。
text: HSBC strategists say persistent scrutiny of the artificial-intelligence trade could be met with surprise this year, if valuations of those stocks start to climb again.
zh: 汇丰银行策略师表示，如果这些股票的估值再次开始攀升，今年对人工智能行业的持续审查可能会令人意外。

title: Gold’s $4,000 skirmish continues as it eyes worst quarter in 13 years
title_zh: 金价 4,000 美元的小冲突仍在继续，预计将迎来 13 年来最糟糕的季度
text: The precious metal may have the calendar on its side, according to an analyst
zh: 一位分析师表示，贵金属可能有日历在身边

title: Strait of Hormuz is reopening faster than expected, says Morgan Stanley as it cuts oil-price target
title_zh: 摩根士丹利下调油价目标后表示，霍尔木兹海峡重新开放的速度快于预期
text: The Strait of Hormuz is reopening faster than expected, oil analysts at Morgan Stanley said as they cut their oil-price view for this year and next.
zh: 摩根士丹利石油分析师在下调今明两年油价预期时表示，霍尔木兹海峡重新开放的速度快于预期。

title: Kylie Jenner takes $48 million ‘concrete fortress’ in L.A. off the market
title_zh: 凯莉·詹纳 (Kylie Jenner) 将洛杉矶价值 4800 万美元的“混凝土堡垒”撤出市场
text: Kylie Jenner has removed her extraordinary concrete megamansion from the market—just six months after listing the modern Los Angeles dwelling for $48 million.
zh: 凯莉·詹纳 (Kylie Jenner) 已将她那栋非凡的混凝土豪宅从市场上撤下——距离这栋现代洛杉矶住宅以 4800 万美元的价格上市仅六个月。

title: Influencer Perez Hilton is selling his Las Vegas home for $4.25 million to move to Miami
title_zh: 影响力人物佩雷斯·希尔顿 (Perez Hilton) 以 425 万美元的价格出售拉斯维加斯的房屋，搬到迈阿密
text: Perez Hilton is selling his Las Vegas home for $4.25 million and moving to Miami after “God told him” to leave Nevada following several health scares.
zh: 佩雷斯·希尔顿 (Perez Hilton) 在经历了几次健康恐慌后，“上帝告诉他”要离开内华达州，他以 425 万美元的价格出售了他在拉斯维加斯的房屋，并搬到了迈阿密。

title: Quant funds just suffered their most crippling trading rout this year as momentum stocks flopped
title_zh: 由于动量股暴跌，量化基金刚刚遭受了今年最严重的交易暴跌
text: Although the last week has been painful for quant funds, asset allocators remind investors that it’s important to look at returns over a wider timeframe. So far in 2026, the sector is still significantly ahead of the S&P 500 and U.S. Treasurys
zh: 尽管上周对量化基金来说是痛苦的，但资产配置者提醒投资者，在更广泛的时间范围内关注回报很重要。 2026 年迄今为止，该行业仍大幅领先于标准普尔 500 指数和美国国债

title: Our economic outlook for China - Vanguard Corporate
title_zh: 我们对中国经济的展望 - Vanguard Corporate
text: Our economic outlook for China Vanguard Corporate
zh: 我们对中国先锋集团的经济展望

title: Inflation likely to stay ‘significantly above target,’ top European central banker warns
title_zh: 欧洲央行行长警告称，通胀可能会“大幅高于目标”
text: Joachim Nagel, president of Germany’s Bundesbank, spoke to CNBC on the sidelines of an ECB conference in Portugal.
zh: 德国央行行长约阿希姆·纳格尔 (Joachim Nagel) 在葡萄牙举行的欧洲央行会议间隙接受 CNBC 采访。

title: Buffett delays annual donation to Gates Foundation pending review of Jeffrey Epstein ties: WSJ
title_zh: 巴菲特推迟对盖茨基金会的年度捐款，等待对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦关系的审查：《华尔街日报》
text: This comes as the foundation continues to review its ties to the late sex offender Jeffery Epstein.
zh: 与此同时，该基金会仍在继续审查其与已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的关系。

title: French biotech stock soars 31% after new data on experimental medicine
title_zh: 实验医学新数据公布后法国生物科技股飙升 31%
text: Shares of French biotech company Abivax soared Tuesday after it released fresh data on its lead drug for bowel disease.
zh: 法国生物技术公司 Abivax 发布其治疗肠道疾病的主要药物的最新数据后，其股价周二飙升。

title: Rafael Nadal talks tennis prize money, his hotels, and what sports taught him about business
title_zh: 拉斐尔·纳达尔谈论网球奖金、他的酒店以及体育教会他的商业知识
text: Rafael Nadal opened his fourth Zel hotel as he expands into hospitality, education and sports after retiring from tennis.
zh: 拉斐尔·纳达尔 (Rafael Nadal) 从网球退役后将业务扩展到酒店、教育和体育领域，开设了他的第四家泽尔酒店 (Zel hotel)。

title: Short sellers keep betting against Pop Mart — even though it's been a losing trade
title_zh: 卖空者继续做空泡泡玛特——尽管这是一笔亏损的交易
text: Short sellers are doubling down on Pop Mart International even as a recent share price recovery turns their bearish bets on the Chinese toymaker increasingly risky.
zh: 尽管最近股价回升，卖空者对泡泡玛特国际的看空押注变得越来越危险，但他们仍在加倍押注泡泡玛特国际。

title: Supreme Court rules Trump cannot fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook for now
title_zh: 最高法院裁定特朗普暂时不能解雇美联储理事丽莎·库克
text: The ruling by the Supreme Court means that Lisa Cook will remain as a Federal Reserve governor as her lawsuit challenging Trump's effort to fire her proceeds.
zh: 最高法院的裁决意味着丽莎·库克将继续担任美联储理事，她的诉讼质疑特朗普解雇她的收益的努力。

title: Oil prices near pre-war levels — but persistent supply risks could spark a rebound, analysts warn
title_zh: 分析师警告称，油价接近战前水平，但持续的供应风险可能引发反弹
text: Commodity strategists warn that Iranian leverage in the Strait of Hormuz will continue to weigh on oil markets and shipping costs.
zh: 大宗商品策略师警告称，伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡的影响力将继续打压石油市场和运输成本。

title: ‘I don’t think I’ll make it to 80’: I’m 70 and single. Do I take out a reverse mortgage or a home-equity agreement?
title_zh: “我不认为我能活到 80 岁”：我已经 70 岁了，还是单身。我是否需要申请反向抵押贷款或房屋净值协议？
text: “I’m torn between these two options.”
zh: “我在这两个选择之间左右为难。”

title: ‘I claimed Social Security at 62’: At 76, I’m working at Walmart. Why do I still owe payroll taxes?
title_zh: “我在 62 岁时领取了社会保障”：76 岁的我在沃尔玛工作。为什么我仍然欠工资税？
text: “It seems like half of the workforce at our local Walmart is over 65.”
zh: “我们当地的沃尔玛似乎有一半员工年龄超过 65 岁。”

title: Rocket Lab to take on SpaceX’s Starlink with $8 billion acquisition
title_zh: Rocket Lab 将斥资 80 亿美元收购 SpaceX 的 Starlink
text: Rocket Lab said it is buying Iridium as a “shortcut” to expanding its growing capabilities.
zh: Rocket Lab 表示，收购 Iridium 作为扩大其不断增长的能力的“捷径”。

title: Bye-bye, ‘HODL’: Strategy now has a plan to sell bitcoin to raise cash and buy its stock
title_zh: 再见，“HODL”：Strategy 现在计划出售比特币以筹集现金并购买其股票
text: Strategy disclosed a program to sell bitcoin “from time to time” to fund its U.S. dollar reserve and share repurchases.
zh: Strategy 披露了一项“不时”出售比特币的计划，为其美元储备和股票回购提供资金。

title: From the US to China, 2025 a blockbuster year for stock markets - Al Jazeera
title_zh: 从美国到中国，2025 年是股市重磅之年 - 半岛电视台

title_zh: 野村证券表示，中国股市的繁荣不会对经济复苏产生太大作用 - 南华早报
text: China’s stock boom will not do much to rejuvenate the economy, Nomura says South China Morning Post
zh: 野村证券表示，中国股市的繁荣不会对经济复苏产生太大作用

text: China’s surging A-share market: Recovery or bubble in disguise? ThinkChina
zh: 中国A股市场飙升：复苏还是变相泡沫？思考中国

title_zh: 随着增长放缓，中国经济政策保持不变 - 墨卡托中国研究中心 (MERICS)
text: China’s economic policy holds line as growth weakens Mercator Institute for China Studies (MERICS)
zh: 随着经济增长疲软，中国经济政策保持不变 墨卡托中国研究中心 (MERICS)

title: Japanese yen sinks to 40-year low, keeping intervention risks in focus
title_zh: 日元跌至40年低点，干预风险继续成为焦点
text: The Japanese yen weakened to its lowest level against the U.S. dollar since 1986 on Tuesday, keeping investors on alert for possible intervention from Japanese authorities.
zh: 周二日元兑美元汇率跌至1986年以来的最低水平，令投资者对日本当局可能采取的干预保持警惕。

title: China factory activity grows faster than expected in June on tech export demand
title_zh: 由于技术出口需求，中国六月份工厂活动增长快于预期
text: China's manufacturing engine held up this year as surging demand for artificial intelligence technology helped offset the drag from Middle East turmoil.
zh: 由于对人工智能技术的需求激增帮助抵消了中东动荡的拖累，中国的制造业引擎今年保持强劲。

title: Trump bought as much as $5 million in Axon stock before ICE sought $220 million Taser deal
title_zh: 在 ICE 寻求 2.2 亿美元泰瑟枪交易之前，特朗普购买了价值 500 万美元的 Axon 股票
text: Axon Enterprise has ramped up lobbying in Congress on federal law enforcement technology as ICE pursues a potential $220 million Taser deal.
zh: 随着 ICE 寻求价值 2.2 亿美元的泰瑟枪交易，Axon Enterprise 加大了在国会就联邦执法技术进行游说的力度。

title: Australia's competition regulator takes Amazon to court over alleged unfair Prime subscription contract terms
title_zh: 澳大利亚竞争监管机构因涉嫌不公平 Prime 订阅合同条款将亚马逊告上法庭
text: Australia's competition regulator is taking Amazon to court, alleging its Prime contracts required subscribers to pay AU$2.99 to avoid advertising, with no option for refunds
zh: 澳大利亚竞争监管机构将亚马逊告上法庭，指控其 Prime 合约要求订户支付 2.99 澳元以避免广告，且无法退款

title: Comcast announces it will spin off NBCUniversal and Sky from cable business
title_zh: 康卡斯特宣布将从有线电视业务中剥离 NBCUniversal 和 Sky
text: Comcast said it will separate into two publicly traded companies through a tax-free spinoff of NBCUniversal and Sky.
zh: 康卡斯特表示，将通过免税分拆 NBCUniversal 和 Sky 分成两家上市公司。

title: Putin’s fuel shortage admission signals growing strain on Russia’s energy infrastructure
title_zh: 普京承认燃料短缺表明俄罗斯能源基础设施的压力日益加大
text: Putin's comments mark the first time he has detailed the extent to which Ukraine's deep-strike successes have hampered Russia's fuel production.
